description: Three-phase power quality analyser with RS485 and Profibus
source: BMR, "PLA33RX Modbus registers", file version 1.2, firmware 1.1.3 and newer
notes: BMR PLA33RX, firmware 1.1.3 and newer. The device reads with FC03 and writes with FC16.
Addresses are written as in the manual, from 0. The manual does not list the RS485 defaults.
Energy counters are int64 in tenths of kWh or kvarh with the least significant register first, as the manual says.

Left out: the data flash files (read with FC23), the Profibus settings (whose addresses in the manual overlap the I/O settings), the alarm settings (the manual recommends the PMS software), the logging bitmaps, the energy counters split into single registers (37100-37195) and the output states at 36000-36003, which the manual gives at the same addresses as the inputs.
